description:
Journal-action extraction in the transaction kernel becomes total: the five `unreachable!` panic sites in the publication path return a typed action-mismatch error that propagates into the existing non-interruption abort with no partial write.

## Background

The transaction kernel bridges two hand-aligned 4-variant action enums - `RepositoryAction` (semantic intent) and `RepositoryJournalActionKind` (staging control-names) - with five `unreachable!` panic sites in `crates/jit/src/storage/file_transaction.rs` (`:759,1079,1088,1097,1104`) that fire mid-publication, after a journal exists. The two enums carry genuinely disjoint payloads, so they stay separate types. Retype the four alignment extractors and the `SetMode`-preimage destructure (`:1079,1088,1097,1104` and `:759`) to return a new `FileTransactionError::JournalActionMismatch { index, expected, found }` over a shared 4-value `ActionTag`, instead of `unreachable!`.

All five sites propagate with `?` into the existing non-interruption abort (cleanup then error, no partial write, `file_transaction.rs:866-876`):
- The four extractor sites (`:1079-:1104`) already sit inside the prepare loop that the abort handler wraps, so `?` reaches the abort directly.
- The `:759` journal-construction site runs after transaction control has been created but before a complete journal exists, so it routes through a control-only teardown: factor the `ControlDirs` removal tail of `cleanup_repository_control` into its own function that skips the journal-dependent data-stage steps (provably no-ops before prepare stages anything), so a mismatch tears down the created control immediately instead of leaving it for later recovery.

Durable journal decode corruption stays with the existing serde and `ControlName` validation paths.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/jit/src/storage/file_transaction.rs` contains no `unreachable!` in the publication path; the five sites (`:759,1079,1088,1097,1104`) return `FileTransactionError::JournalActionMismatch { index, expected, found }` over a shared `ActionTag`.
- [hard] REQ-02: All five sites propagate with `?` into the existing non-interruption abort, leaving no partial write; the `:759` site tears down created control through the factored control-only teardown that skips journal-dependent data-stage steps.
- [hard] REQ-03: `RepositoryAction` and `RepositoryJournalActionKind` remain separate types with their disjoint payloads.
- [hard] REQ-04: The existing interruption tests pass unchanged; behavior is preserved.

## Notes

File ownership for this task is `crates/jit/src/storage/file_transaction.rs` and `crates/jit/src/storage/transaction_journal.rs`.
title: Total journal-action extraction in the transaction kernel
